lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: A few hundred, maybe. Out of thousands. The rest are on that plain or in the garrison's cages.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: This is on me. I built them a sword and forgot that someone else could pick it up and swing it.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: I'm the one who told them they could win. That makes it mine as well. Gather the crew. Whatever we do next, we do it without an army.
